[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Rachel was born in 1801. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2304|Archibald Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1855.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2304]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The Gilders Creek inscription account names Rachel, died 1855, as a daughter of Archibald and Mary. The same cemetery family and Archibald’s 1818 estate identify this selected father directly.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the stone photograph with its published reading and estate.

Source basis already held: [https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/gilders_creek_cem.htm Gilders Creek Cemetery survey and photographs (https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/gilders_creek_cem.htm), Newberry County, South Carolina, entries for Archibald and the Glasgow family.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
